reason: Both meet the hard requirements, but Response B's step ordering is more temporally coherent: it takes the initial backup before replication setup, starts bulk/CDC sync well ahead of the maintenance window, and only takes the final backup at the start of the window before cutover. Response A numbers its pre-cutover backup (step 6) before beginning continuous replication (step 7), which for a 2 TB database implies the bulk copy would only start right at the maintenance window, undermining the near-zero-downtime cutover it describes.
